judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service, canonical audit/selection and applicable saved plans/reports. [STAGE-EVIDENCE] defines audit, instrumentation, verification and the genuine standalone prerequisite-negative exception.

Use filesystem/tool-visible source and raw evidence; retrieve required slices hidden by truncation. A retained file, successful command or archived but unread output alone does not establish the selected source fact.

Executed positive evidence includes unchanged host-checker raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof artifacts, stdout/stderr and exact received SDK joins. The independent workflow reruns that checker; actor success claims are not independent receipts.

Mechanical evidence: inspect supplied evidence-receipt-check.json and bound .observe/otel-evidence-receipt.json as deterministic facts, not another LLM verdict. Missing/stale/mismatched required gates independently block workflow acceptance, even when every semantic check passes. Do not recompute hashes, schema or index membership in the judge. Standalone executed proof still needs retained packaged validation or an explicitly unresolved gate; [BAKED-EVIDENCE] judges its provenance, while [CLAIM-COMPLETENESS] judges promise coverage.

Studio evicts live telemetry after producer exit. The host checker captures while alive and then cleans up; this proves live capture/cleanup, not post-exit persistence or final-record drain. Those selected claims need their own receipts.

Each [TOPIC] is a separate acceptance decision. Name its unmet predicate and evidence, and explain legitimate non-applicability without runtime credit. When two topics describe the same omission, fail only its owning topic and cite that owner in the other's notes. Inventory/readback topics need their own distinct inventory/readback omission. Mechanical gate failure is a separate deterministic result, not an automatic semantic failure. Evidence may be shared. If one cause independently violates different predicates, explain the shared cause rather than reporting independent defects; do not cascade verdicts.
rubric: [STAGE-EVIDENCE] Use the requested loaded skill on the actual service. Audit is read-only: missing SDK/export/owned propagation are source gaps and future acceptance, not executed facts. Instrumentation implements the authorized/default baseline through real startup, project checks and normal verification; the unchanged host checker must pass, so plans/Not run do not satisfy execution. Verification executes bound read-only checks on the supplied instrumented workspace. Only an untouched standalone verification fixture genuinely missing required audit/selection permits an exact prerequisite blocker without edits, invented reports or runtime success. Inspect those preconditions first; then mark inapplicable executable checks 'Not applicable: prerequisite-negative; no runtime coverage credit' without demanding post-gate analysis. This exception is unavailable in the paired instrumented workflow. Optional delegation advice requires neither another model nor proof of comprehension.

[CANONICAL-BINDINGS] Preserve canonical audit/selection digests, established IDs, source and stage authority. Verification must not edit or rebind the audit; instrumentation implements only authorized scope. Do not withdraw established, critical or operator requirements to evade their checks. A direct workflow without an audit uses its actual plan/result/source evidence and must not fabricate canonical audit, selection or verification JSON.

[SELECTED-CONTRACT] Before finalizing new audit IDs or a direct plan, inspect the full selected saved contract: procedural fixes, acceptance/shared constraints, telemetry fields, scenario triggers/outcomes, environments, imported evidence parameterizations, event order and selected source/operator promises. Follow referenced/unprojected context. required-controls --view contracts or equivalent complete inspection may expose this material; default telemetry hints are not a complete inventory. Transitive completed/manual/external prerequisites are context to inspect, not approved work, executable availability or closure. Retrieve required source slices omitted by truncated tool output before relying on them.

[ADDRESSABLE-ORACLES] Give every selected variant and required outcome an addressable assertion, input and feasible observation boundary, retaining conditional metadata. A complete shared/grouped parameterization is valid when each member's actual inputs, expected outcome and required independent observation are explicit; duplicated tests, row-local prose and literal case names are unnecessary. A source-implied property counts only when violating it fails that same bound assertion/path for the selected phase; related success cannot imply an orthogonal property such as nonblocking behavior.

[SAVED-READBACK] After the last promise-changing edit, inspect the saved contract and reconcile final expectations, including shared constraints and referenced parameterizations. Generating an unread projection is not readback. Audit plans need this saved-expectation reconciliation, without application execution. Delegation advice is not execution/approval evidence: the parent verifies concrete findings under existing authority, reruns affected checks or retains gaps. Without a delegated context, the same self-readback duty applies; no extra model is required.

[EXECUTION-FRESHNESS] Rerun affected checks after the last relevant code/test/configuration change and read their regenerated final outputs. Bind evidence to current source, dependencies, commands, actual case/input identity and outcome counts; retain failures. Honor required project runtimes and configured local endpoints. A copied receipt or zero exit without execution cannot prove the selected current run. Distinct trials/inputs need actual storage/input identity; case-only paths may alias on a case-insensitive filesystem.

[DERIVED-STATUS] Derive each control/item status, direct-assertion flag, proof mode, visibility, trace IDs and remaining work from its own assertions/raw outcomes. Keep unmatched required controls Not proven; related passes, copied acceptance or unconditional summary assignments cannot close them. Attribute IDs only to that operation/phase; context-only valid unsampled observations may retain their own IDs, outside context has none, and unknown ownership stays unresolved. A direct item assertion can pass with incomplete ancillary scenarios only when the claimed item scope remains accurate.

[CONFIG-SCOPE] Assess app-owned/new overrides, supplied selected settings, inputs necessary to application/operator invariants, and every actual capability/default claim at its claimed scope. An unchanged versioned delegated default is a source fact, not a runtime conformance promise for every upstream input. Keep precise ownership/default/unsupported/unverified dispositions; do not invent unused SDK permutation suites, but do not use delegation to excuse ignored active inputs, false exact claims or unresolved critical invariants.

[CONFIG-READER] For each required setting, identify its actual public option or operator/environment reader and terminal consumption. Resolve accessible conversion, precedence, sentinel/default translation, units, validation/clamps, merge/detector ordering and diagnostic delegates. Distinguish native API values from serialized representations and separate owners/defaults. A supporting SDK may consume environment values without a new application parser; a public option or unused helper alone does not prove startup wiring.

[CONFIG-INPUTS] Allocate input classes actually reaching the selected reader or precisely claimed behavior: applicable casing, empty/unset, invalid, numeric/fractional/range/overflow, enum/no-op, fallback and higher-priority cases. Bind promised values, rejections and diagnostics to discriminating assertions through the actual caller and its fallback tuple. Fixed typed options/valid SDK values used only to establish test state need applied value, units, actual reader and startup/intended-state evidence, not an unrelated parser suite. Clearing a parent key proves absence only if startup/child overrides do not restore it. This topic owns selected reader/parser input-class predicates; the normal-launch Resource identity profiles belong to [NORMAL-LAUNCH]. Do not duplicate a missing identity launch here.

[SIGNAL-ACTIVATION] Allocate every selected/promised exporter and activation mode per signal, including reachable absent/empty, none/other and protocol branches. Preserve SDK-disabled versus retained propagation and distinct bridge flags; logs-only opt-out does not prove trace/metric selectors. A selected non-OTLP gate must prove no added local OTLP pipeline and preserved native output without installing an unselected exporter. Keep supported-transport versus rejected-transport outcomes consistent with the plan, using actual owner normalization rather than another language's rules.

[PROOF-BOUNDARY] Use evidence-row proof modes from the actual assertion path: isolated SDK/bridge unit, decoded loopback SDK unit+otlp, actual application setup/helper app_test, or claimed normal application path full_runtime. Audit proof_level selects planned focused call-site/full-runtime or justified either; it is not an execution mode. Either requires adequate alternatives for the same contract. Each scalar mode/visibility must cover its assertion's constituents and same-path conjunctions. Do not borrow another probe's strongest boundary or automatically downgrade direct runtime item proof because ancillary scenarios are focused/incomplete. Optional modes require their effective source-backed names/units/fields/aliases, not an unqualified baseline oracle.

[NORMAL-LAUNCH] Plan/prove selected Resource identity variants through the real launcher, not helpers: Resource-only service.name, explicit supported override and absent identity when selected. Fallbacks must preserve SDK-parsed operator identity, accepted encodings/whitespace and unrelated attributes. Build the actual child environment without conflicting inherited keys and account for loaders/profiles. Promised service.version/other fields need their own expected values and assertions; unavailable unpromised metadata stays absent. Credit host-checker profiles only for their observed logs/spans and fields: supplied name/version/other attributes do not prove metrics Resource, fully absent/default identity, percent-encoding, headers or maturity. Audit allocates these controls without executing them. Own the Resource identity launch profiles; other selected parser input classes belong to [CONFIG-INPUTS].

[OPERATION-COVERAGE] Bind selected source operations/list members and promised outcomes to their predicates, parameters, outputs, lifecycle phases and asserting scenarios. A complete global scan/shared parameterization is valid with explicit capture scope and witnesses for each selected operation/phase; a broad 'all captured records' claim or literal name match is insufficient. Inventory the selected application/framework/server producers using matching implementation/public API/artifact or permitted bytecode plus inspected symbols. An unresolved producer/event/API edge needs its owner and next discriminating source/probe observation; SDK mapper metadata alone is not producer evidence. Work prioritization is guidance, not mandatory tool-call chronology.

[FINDING-CLOSURE] For each independently selectable finding, trace the actual changes/producers its assertions consume through its owner and transitive prerequisites, including required other-signal producers. A repair owned only by a dependent/unselected finding is unavailable. Allocate privacy trails to their owning logging finding, rather than borrowing another finding's pass. Request/worker/log integration belongs to the finding owning the complete path. Group coupled repairs when no independent deliverable contract exists, without cycles or lost invariants. Correct declared IDs/dependencies alone do not establish semantic acceptance closure.

[PROPAGATION-COMPONENTS] For selected/configured composite propagation, bind every promised active component, carrier direction and metadata field to its own assertion through actual initialization. For application-owned SDK-disabled guards, prove the selected propagation setup remains reachable and carrier extraction works through that disabled path. Provider registration or TraceContext-only evidence cannot prove another component; propagation does not authorize baggage capture into logs. Preserve effective authority/precedence and distinguish unchanged environment bytes from a programmatic override's actual policy.

[EXPECTED-MANIFEST] Judge each declared control's semantic binding: owning run/operation, lifecycle phase, typed expected outcome and feasible assertion boundary. HTTP controls require joint method AND outcome selection; a shared span name/trial is not operation ownership. Grouped controls/evidence reuse need explicit witnesses for their declared operation/phase/fact. Audit plans these bindings and capture/import boundaries without inventing a ledger or execution. Enumeration of all selected promises belongs to [CLAIM-COMPLETENESS]; do not fail this topic solely for a missing manifest member.

[BAKED-EVIDENCE] For representable instrumentation/verification execution, actually invoke the packaged evidence-bake path on an explicit manifest and source-bound JSON/JSONL captured or verified-import ledger, retaining generated JSON/Markdown. A future instruction, handwritten union or valid schema is insufficient. Verified source_import evidence may reuse ownership without a new token. Inspect capture/import interpretation and raw locators for truth; tools validate mechanical ownership/types/hashes, not adapter truth. Unrepresentable evidence needs a concrete limitation and adequate own-source reconciliation, not a false tool pass. Executed completion requires the final report-bound receipt and retained successful packaged validation, with actual invocation/provenance. Missing, failed or unresolved required validation stays incomplete and cannot satisfy executed completion; truthful disclosure alone does not close it. Read the trusted tool result without recomputing mechanical validity. The workflow independently enforces that gate regardless of semantic verdicts.

[CLAIM-COMPLETENESS] Own coverage of every selected promise in the actual final report/contract, including required grouped members: reconcile them against the manifest and direct-report declared index. A baker/index checker cannot discover an undeclared branch. Judge the adequacy of present domain predicates in their owning topics; judge declared-control binding in [EXPECTED-MANIFEST], without duplicating the same missing promise here and there. Audits need executable allocation, not an execution index/receipt; genuine not-run/prerequisite reports retain concrete reasons without fabricated observations. Mechanical consistency is a separate deterministic gate, not this coverage verdict.

[LOG-OWNERSHIP] Identify actual native logger, SDK/agent/provider/bridge owners and startup reachability, with one supported owner per record and preserved original sinks. Establish each selected application/framework/server native route after its actual initialization through a supported public configuration/startup mechanism, preserving level, format, multiplicity and opt-outs. Obtaining a sibling logger, ancestor handler eligibility, a producer filter or an underscored lazy initializer alone does not prove native bootstrap. Environment variables alone do not prove a working pipeline.

[RECORD-SEMANTICS] Preserve actual WARN/severity mapping, source occurrence versus observed time, useful bounded Body and supported structured values. Derive exact SeverityText casing from the selected source/bridge; numeric severity bands prescribe no casing, and a permitted short-name substitute may fill absent text, not replace present text. Do not invent mandatory EventName, exception payloads or unsupported capabilities. log.record.original is conditionally permitted for a string-like original AND differing Body; do not invent a converse prohibition.

[EXACT-SPAN-JOINS] Plan/prove canonical log TraceId AND SpanId against exact real SDK spans, parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Derive expected SpanId from the context actually selected by the bridge/API, including supported caller-side capture. Ordinary attributes, nonempty/shared trace IDs or stdout correlation are insufficient. A verified framework INTERNAL child with correct request ancestry is legitimate; do not force SERVER-only topology, delete layer spans, copy IDs or force sampling. A supported-stack positive workflow still needs its real end-to-end join. Assess real peer carriers/propagator capability; unsupported valid carriers remain dependency conformance gaps, not successful joins or permission to strip flags/raise the runtime floor.

[ASYNC-CONTEXT] Address the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right pairing; separate sync/async probes do not prove worker-to-real-span integration. Selected reuse needs the same execution unit under distinct work-item contexts and context-free work. A selected missing-transfer negative needs valid independently observed caller SDK context at scheduling in both cases, varying only transfer on the same path with detach/restore. Scheduling after scope exit or outside-context emit is not that negative. Scope cancellation/error controls to existing owned behavior or labeled supported probes; do not invent business cancellation or count span ending as work cancellation.

[UNSAMPLED-OUTSIDE] Distinguish valid unsampled/outside context from broken wiring: no stale request IDs on startup, fabricated spans or forced sampling. Exact unsampled claims compare canonical IDs/flags against independently observed SDK context chosen by the logging API for that record/boundary, including explicit context/caller capture. Later export-worker ambient context, two agreeing logs or a nonempty SpanId is insufficient. Do not require exported unsampled spans or production identifier fields. Audit selects a supported observation/mode; focused evidence cannot close a bound full-runtime exact-value claim.

[PRIVACY-BOUNDARY] Do not introduce raw request IDs or unbounded errors. Apply the selected source/operator privacy policy to all records captured by the chosen bridge, including actual handled/escaping framework producers. Retain producer/call-site → native event → supported hook/action → later renderers → native/SDK outputs, proving forbidden-sentinel absence at the selected boundary and distinguishing registration/enqueue from callback invocation/completion. Do not invent an earlier lifecycle boundary. Captured framework violations belong to the authorized logging baseline, including direct instrumentation; repair supported logging-only sanitization without requiring a new business audit, preserving IDs/exclusions. A genuinely unsupported hook remains an exact owned gap; blanket suppression is not redaction.

[PERMITTED-FIELDS] A selected privacy repair must preserve permitted diagnostic categories, effective level, native sinks and application behavior in actual rendered native output AND SDK/wire output. Inspect real producer formatting/decorations and typed fields/template arguments before bounded extraction; losing non-success method/status or asserting only a safe extra substring is insufficient. Keep fixed Body/category and existing format policy. Bounded left/right categories are allowed; ordinary native messages need no instrumentation-only exception event. Assert each selected operation's useful fields without invented attributes, payload/header capture or universal bans beyond operator policy.

[LIMIT-READER] Resolve effective selected log attribute count/value limits or unlimited behavior, default/fallback/programmatic precedence and startup-to-provider/bridge enforcement. Public options/processors alone do not establish forwarding or bypass; inspect accessible normalizer/diagnostic delegates even before installation. Span limits do not configure log limits, and Body/privacy policy and Resource exemptions remain distinct. Unchanged delegated defaults may use precise versioned ownership or unsupported/unverified evidence, without an unused-setting suite or false runtime claim.

[LIMIT-VALUES] For selected bounds/shapes, distinguish strings/characters from byte arrays, recursive array/map value limits from top-level count, supported depth/replacement and real discard/eviction accounting. Plan/probe below/at/above selected bounds through the promised native bridge when applicable; direct SDK emission cannot prove that path. Preserve bridge-added attributes, each selected span/event's own SDK attribute-limit container and accumulated drops; a parent count or successful truncation cannot establish event accounting. Keep unsupported/development shapes explicit without SDK replacement/upgrades.

[LIMIT-DIAGNOSTICS] For selected limit diagnostics, first establish limit-induced record-data truncation/discard/replacement; invalid-key/uniqueness messages or unchanged-value config warnings do not automatically qualify. Common diagnostics MAY occur, affected-record cadence MUST be at most once, and Logs SDK discard diagnostics retain their separate SHOULD. Follow helpers through caller state updates, aggregation and terminal once guards. Distinguish source-known emission/no-emission from executed cadence and configured sink visibility; retain false source-resolvable absence claims and upstream limitations honestly.

[CONSTRUCTION-COST] Guard actually expensive selected log construction using supported enablement checks, proving disabled/filter/opt-out avoids that work at the selected path. Cheap fixed messages need no artificial guards. Unverified SDK defaults cannot close a selected safe-cost/privacy/operator-limit invariant. Do not impose arbitrary Body caps, fabricated capture paths, duplicate providers/suppression or forced upgrades.

[DELIVERY-STATES] Separate native calls, enqueue, attempts, received copies, acknowledged/accepted/rejected/dropped/unknown and persisted outcomes under actual batch/exporter/lifecycle owners. Derive each signal/phase's serialized status, visibility and direct assertion from its own raw records, response and terminal client result. Zero received logs may satisfy an expected fault without log otlp_accepted; another healthy/recovered branch cannot supply that outcome's visibility. Preserve existing weaker/unknown states and counts without new enums. Client success, decoded acknowledgement and independent persistence are different evidence.

[OTLP-ACK] When response classification is selected/claimed, decode each request's N and bind its batch/attempt to the terminal client outcome. Conforming HTTP200 plus correct ExportLogsServiceResponse encoding and unset partial_success acknowledges N/0; populated rejected R acknowledges N−R/R; populated warning-only R=0 acknowledges N/0. Populated partial/warning cases MUST NOT retry. Invalid/unrelated200 bodies or SDK success alone prove neither decoding nor acceptance. Account for every received request and terminal outcome; retain unresolved negative/size acceptance as unknown. Ordinary OTLP use alone does not select a protocol conformance suite.

[RETRY-CLASSIFICATION] Selected retry controls distinguish completed negative responses from stalls through actual client/receiver evidence, with per-outcome counts/raw links. Use a retry-capable policy and a positive retryable control to prove no-retry behavior; disabled/exhausted retries do not. HTTP429/502/503/504 SHOULD retry; other4xx/5xx MUST NOT. Preserve operator policy, selected standard transient-error exponential backoff/jitter, transport-correct Retry-After/RetryInfo and remaining-budget conditions. Server intent/null counts/aggregate elapsed time do not establish a client outcome; never add an application retry loop to expose SDK internals.

[DEADLINE-BUDGET] Trace selected exact deadlines through creation, propagation, retries/waits and terminal consumption, retaining units, effective defaults/fallbacks and measured overshoot. Distinguish configured/per-attempt/whole-export budgets and earlier caller cancellation; standard export budgets include all attempts/waits and cannot restart per request. A throttle beyond remaining budget must not cause early retry. After-failure elapsed time, process/shutdown duration or an assigned timeout alone does not prove a strict batch ceiling. Preserve selected processor Export synchronization without duplicate application locks or confusing exporter request concurrency.

[PENDING-DRAIN] For selected shutdown-drain proof, identify a genuine queued/pending record at the provider-drain boundary through the normal launcher and configured application stop path, with effective queue/schedule/batch conditions. A pre-stop emit may already have exported; a held receiver response may prove only in-flight export. Bind that record's own decoded receipt before actual SDK-child exit through receiver observation plus child liveness or an actual awaited receipt→conforming-ack→shutdown causal chain. ObservedTimestamp may be SDK emission time, not ingestion order; after-exit queries, nil shutdown, exit zero or launcher wait timing alone are insufficient. Own pending-state and receipt-before-exit ordering; final record field/multiplicity predicates belong to [FINAL-RECORD].

[FINAL-RECORD] Run the selected final-record predicate against that stop cycle's actual record/phase/window: per-body/identity multiplicities, Body/severity, expected Resource and both context IDs or required absence. An aggregate count can hide a missing record plus duplicate. Healthy joins, focused export, opt-out, live snapshots or cleanup do not substitute. Reuse real application logs where possible; no production log solely for testing or arbitrary tuning. Safely executable selected instrumentation drain remains required unless genuinely blocked; retained shutdown errors and child lifetime constrain the claim. Own final-record content and multiplicities; queue state and receipt-before-exit ordering belong to [PENDING-DRAIN].

[REPEATED-STOP] For selected stop controls, name the request kind, recipient, launcher→effective application handler/finalizer, expected outcome and source-backed budget/order. Resolve handler registration/removal/default fallback after the first request. Deliver the selected same/mixed second signal to the same process during active final logging/provider drain, without resetting the budget, and retain its outcome. An uninterrupted-drain policy requires non-interruption and once-only finalization, without default termination or another finalizer; permitted forced-repeat termination is a distinct outcome and cannot imply graceful drain or final receipt. Fixture README Graceful-stop policy is application policy, not a universal OTel signal requirement.

[LATE-CALLBACK] For a selected late-callback suppression/bound or lifecycle claim, follow dispatch/cleanup registrations, retained references, actual closed state, invocation and terminal effect. Detaching dispatch is not callback cancellation; invocation, completed teardown, cancellation and benign idempotence are distinct. A source-backed idempotent closed owner may make a remaining callback harmless: prove that selected effect/budget instead of demanding callback removal, unsupported registry manipulation or inferring a runtime hang merely from possible invocation.

[RETRY-LINEAGE] A selected retry trial names a source-supported retryable response/connection event, actual batch/trial identity, SDK policy/wait source, remaining budget, measured waits and terminal outcome. Distinguish failed-batch recovery from later healthy batches and persistent exhaustion/deadline termination. Existing SDK backoff/jitter can suffice without server throttling. Request fingerprints, timestamps and bound client outcomes establish lineage; different decoded record sets, a generic failure/stall label, server intent or another export's deadline do not. Keep unmatched client outcomes unknown rather than assigning acceptance.

[APP-FAULT-PATH] Audit allocates a feasible fault/isolation boundary. Execution claims exercise actual application initialization, production provider/processor path (including selected batching), bridge and real operations. An instance-local transport/exporter seam can establish app_test; SDK-only substitutes cannot prove that conjunction. Preserve production guards/shared receivers and avoid global transport interception/redirection. Keep selected independent direct-export/processor/cancellation/persistent-failure controls, without an unselected fault crossproduct or business feature. Separate normal-launch proof from focused application tests.

[DIAGNOSTIC-OBSERVATION] For selected diagnostic counts/absence, follow the actual emitting operation through caller/aggregate routes, logger/handler and configured sink. Internal SDK logging and public error-handler routing may differ; a counting-handler replacement cannot establish the original native route. Calibrate the actual source-supported predicate with a retained discriminating positive where emission occurs, raw matched evidence and measurement window. Source calls/once guards do not prove runtime visibility; configured suppression or source non-emission may explain zero, without new production diagnostics. A helper lacking warnings or one handler's setup cannot establish every operation's absence; an enabled untested pipeline is not 'not configured'.

[FAULT-CLEANUP] Retain diagnostic observation through the selected work's terminal client/diagnostic outcome, including controlled post-timeout release/cleanup before restoring test-owned handlers/sinks. A finished caller wait is not finished work. If capture ends first, keep outstanding effects unknown and finish bounded owned cleanup without attributing them to the next trial. Variable payloads or late completion must not yield a false-zero/upper-bound pass. Reconcile saved summaries with calibrated raw predicates, actual windows and cleanup/restoration order.

[LIVE-FAULT-ORDER] Continued-operation claims require the selected log failure/refusal to be observed by the originating SDK/client before subsequent application/native work, or a still-blocked operation explicitly overlapping that progress. Audit plans this order; execution retains its event observations while the application/producers are alive. Receiver request arrival/response status alone is not client observation. A fault first exercised at shutdown cannot prove live isolation; pending-drain long batch schedules remain separately scoped. Unexecuted fault cases stay unproven.

[INDEPENDENT-SIGNALS] For selected log-fault isolation, prove each other configured signal's progress with decoded received traces/metrics attributable to its selected originating operations after the observed client failure or during the selected blocked interval. Signal path, timestamp or byte size alone is insufficient. Decode actual producer-owned receipts; healthy unrelated branches or before-fault traffic cannot close the selected continued-operation claim.

[APP-COMPATIBILITY] Preserve application routes/behavior, legitimate layer spans, native sinks and supported runtime/consumer compatibility. Keep added local logs local and existing trace/metric behavior intact; make no unrequested cloud configuration, SDK upgrade, unrelated business instrumentation or runtime-floor increase. Repair authorized logging-baseline failures without discarding explicit exclusions or user-owned configuration.

[SOURCE-CLAUSES] For selected app/operator behavior, changed configuration, source-backed risks and actual capability claims, retain primary source/version/date, bound conditions, strength, owner/disposition and proof boundary. Exact normative/conformance or revision claims need the actual inspected primary slice and section/operation; a remembered revision, generic URL, unrelated range or SDK comment is insufficient. Bounded excerpts or exact immutable evidence-row references may carry unchanged clauses. Source-known defaults may use compact versioned dispositions; no precise revision is invented when only URL/date is established. PR-wide exhaustive clause inventories are not repeated bare-workflow deliverables.

[DUTY-OWNERS] Allocate selected duties to actual SDK, bridge, instrumentation/semantic-convention author, application, receiver or operator. Supported SDK guarantees need no duplicate app implementation; unchanged unselected sibling duties need no per-service clause ledger or exhaustive certification. Retain accurate source/default/unsupported/unverified conditions and next resolution steps, refreshing capabilities after install/probes. Delegated/external limitations cannot close a selected critical app invariant or retrospectively remove its promise. Avoid arbitrary tuning, mandatory framework recipes and SDK rewrites/upgrades for upstream limitations.

[TRANSPORT-BOUNDS] Select transport-size/decompression duties only for an app-owned/changed bound, supplied operator policy, source-backed risk or precise capability/conformance claim. Ordinary delegated HTTP export, endpoint/timeout setup or an acknowledged status/body limitation does not select sibling duties. Apply only the selected surface and HTTP or corresponding gRPC clauses. Recommended64MiB request/4MiB response sizes are not mandatory app tuning; configurability remains SHOULD. For a selected receiver request bound, retain bounding/decompression MUST and HTTP413 on overflow. For a selected exporter request bound, retain pre-compression bounding SHOULD, MUST NOT send above an active bound and discard-diagnostic SHOULD. For a selected client response bound, retain bounding/decompression MUST, non-retryable-oversize MUST and discard-diagnostic SHOULD. For a selected receiver response bound, retain pre-compression bounding MUST; oversized partial responses SHOULD be reduced without semantic change when possible/practical, MAY trim optional diagnostics, and still-oversize responses MUST return HTTP500 with acceptance unspecified. Bind each selected bound/reader, input and send/discard/response outcome to its actual owner. A request check, timeout or client simulation cannot certify another surface or external receiver. External ownership needs an honest disposition; actual receiver implementation/conformance claims require evidence there, not ordinary-app certification.

[EXACT-API] Resolve concrete repair and exact capability/default/absence claims through the declaring public symbol, chosen overload, terminal native/container conversion and actual consuming implementation, including parser/default/retry/diagnostic delegates. An interface signature, documentation, different reader's sentinel or unused helper cannot establish that concrete path. Source-resolvable contradictions remain failures despite a Not run disclaimer; scoped probes establish only their actual boundary. Preserve private-extension applicability instead of imposing unrelated standard defaults.

[NORMATIVE-DIRECTION] Read final generated normative prose against its actual source binding's subject, operation, condition, consequent/direction, requirement strength and qualifiers. A correct source file/initial ledger does not prove a final reversed implication or unsupported converse. Keep recommendations, permissions, mandatory fallbacks, normative imports and compatibility qualifications distinct; do not strengthen a SHOULD/MAY into an unconditional app MUST or weaken a selected MUST into an optional disposition.

[ONEMIT-CONTRACT] For selected processor behavior/risk/conformance, distinguish SDK-owned OnEmit synchronous emitting-thread execution, nonblocking/nonthrowing SHOULD and directly registered mutation-visibility MUST. An application-owned callback needs its concrete work/actions and applicable assertion or exact limitation; SDK guarantees or synchrony alone do not establish application nonblocking/nonthrowing behavior. When a selected filtering processor supports Enabled or wraps one, assess independent OnEmit filtering; LoggerConfig defaults alone do not select it. Unchanged unselected SDK callbacks need no inventory or duplicate implementation.

[MATURITY] Qualify selected maturity separately for the normative data model/specification and actual installed/proposed SDK, bridge and component/API. Stable record semantics do not establish component stability; one component's source comment cannot label the whole language beta. Retain absent/uninspected status honestly and refresh actual capability outcomes after installation/probes, without forced upgrades or inherited runtime success.

[BRIDGE-ERROR-AUTHORITY] For a newly owned global bridge, preserve existing custom/strict error-handler authority and establish an independent error route before provider/bridge activation. A returned global delegator is not a historical native-handler snapshot. An existing safe route needs no replacement. Bind the actual failure operation and handler authority; generic setup or a counting substitute cannot prove preservation of the selected native error route.

[NAME-SYNTAX] For selected new telemetry names, preserve valid-Unicode MUST, lowercase/dot/snake SHOULD and established-concatenation-over-underscore SHOULD with ecosystem evidence and compatibility; an individual API/SDK spelling alone is insufficient. Optional log.iostream must use an applicable known value when available; custom values otherwise MAY be used. Do not turn naming recommendations or optional fields into unconditional application features.

[SEMANTIC-EVENT-DEFINITION] For a selected formal Development semantic-event definition, retain MUST NOT prescribe ObservedTimestamp or SeverityText and Body only as a string display message. This constraint concerns formal event definitions, not SDK-populated fields or structured ordinary log Body. Do not invent mandatory EventName, prohibit legitimate ordinary record values or claim stable SDK/API maturity from event-model semantics.

[LOCAL-DESTINATION] For selected local-log policy, resolve the actual winning programmatic/file/loader/environment/child-VM input, then compare effective transport, authority/port and signal path to the detected/approved receiver or explicitly authorized fixture tuple. Loopback alone is not identity; enrollment from whichever endpoint the current runtime supplies is not independent approval. Approved signal-specific logs A must survive unused generic B. Preserve authorized alternate receivers and supported resolution without runtime discovery, a universal fixed port or silent operator-policy override; retain exact unresolved boundaries. Own destination approval/resolution; credential preservation and cross-signal isolation belong to [CREDENTIAL-ISOLATION].

[CREDENTIAL-ISOLATION] Preserve valid signal-specific local-log headers through official SDK parsing without empty overrides; generic-header conflicts stay isolated to the added local log path, with trace/metric settings and native output preserved. Required credential migration/removal belongs to operator-resolved preflight configuration. Application startup must not pop generic headers or copy/rewrite them into signal variables merely to activate logs. Selected winning-input conflicts need actual credential/activation and independent-signal assertions, not only environment helper checks. [HTTP-ENDPOINTS] For selected OTLP/HTTP resolution, use signal-specific URLs as-is, including root when their path is absent. Preserve the full generic base path and append v1/<signal> after a separating slash; a signal-looking suffix does not authorize replacing that path. Reuse the actual SDK resolution owner where supported. Bind selected precedence/protocol cases to effective consumption rather than merely inspecting environment text or adding a universal custom parser.

[COMMAND-BOUNDARY] For a selected zero-code/launcher command boundary, ensure arguments after the application-command separator remain application arguments and cannot silently override the settings already checked by local policy. Resolve the actual installed command reader and effective child invocation; a helper or preflight result before later option rewriting cannot establish this boundary. Preserve supported operator/application options and keep unsupported combinations explicit without replacing the general command parser.

[METRIC-SEMANTICS] For a selected stable/legacy instrumentation mode or metric capability claim, bind actual effective mode to source-backed metric names, units, fields and compatibility aliases, then plan/prove them at the declared application boundary. A baseline-mode metric oracle cannot stand unqualified when an operator-selected/promised mode changes it. Unchanged source-only modes need no hypothetical runtime crossproduct, and optional metadata is not invented.

[EXCEPTION-CAPTURE] For a selected decorator/context-manager exception promise, resolve actual escaping-exception auto-recording/status and explicit same-span recording. Prevent selected duplicate records without suppressing the legitimate escaping outcome; distinguish a fully handled successful operation from an error escaping the selected context. Bind the actual API path and operator privacy policy rather than inventing extra exception events or a universal ban on supported exception fields.
